caption: Takes one item kind out of a line of mixed items, 15 blocks a slice: slices stand side by side one kind each, at full hopper speed, and a full chest never jams the line or drains a neighbour. The filter hopper holds 41 of its kind and 4 named fillers (comparator signal 2); one more item makes signal 3, the only level that gets through three dust to the repeater, which powers the torch's block; the torch (under the comparator's block, which locks the drain hopper) turns off, and the drain hopper, kept full (64 of the kind and 4 other named fillers) so the filter can never push its recipe into it, drops one item into the chest and takes one from the filter. 16-stack items: 10 + 4 in the filter, 16 + 4 in the drain. It cannot sort non-stackable items (tools, armour: they pass through) nor items whose name or enchantments differ from the recipe's. Catalog parts: the NOT gate (a torch on a block) as the lock, a 2 gt repeater.
